abstract: This study was undertaken to determine the clinical course of patients with intratubular malignant germ cells (ITMGCs) and to evaluate the reliability of placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) for detection of these cells. Eight patients with ITMGCs in testicular biopsy were followed. Four patients received no further immediate treatment. Two of these showed no evidence of disease after 190 and 132 mo; one developed seminoma at 38 mo, and one developed seminoma of the contralateral testis in 61 mo. The remaining four patients underwent immediate orchiectomy. Orchiectomy findings were invasive seminoma in three testes, intratubular seminoma in one, and residual ITMGCs in one testis (one patient had bilateral orchiectomy). Also studied were two testicular biopsies from patients with known retroperitoneal germ cell tumors, respectively, seminoma and teratoma. Both had ITMGCs in their testes. Immunoperoxidase stains for PLAP gave a positive result in all biopsies showing intratubular malignant germ cells. PLAP was not demonstrated in spermatogonia in 471 control biopsies which did not show germ cell neoplasia. Two other patients with incidental seminoma on biopsy for infertility are discussed. These results show that ITMGCs show a high rate of progression to invasive disease, but can show an indolent course. PLAP is a sensitive and specific marker for ITMGC, facilitating diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 精細管内悪性胚細胞(ITMGC)を有する8例の臨床経過を調べ、これらの細胞の検出における胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の信頼性を評価した。4例は直ちに追加治療を受けなかった。そのうち2例は190か月および132か月にわたり病変を認めず、1例は38か月後にセミノーマを発症し、1例は61か月後に対側精巣にセミノーマを発症した。残りの4例は直ちに精巣摘除術を受けた。精巣摘除術の所見は、3精巣で浸潤性セミノーマ、1精巣で精細管内セミノーマ、1精巣で残存ITMGCであった（1例は両側精巣摘除を受けた）。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍が既知の患者2例（それぞれセミノーマおよび奇形腫）の精巣生検も検討した。両例とも精巣にITMGCを認めた。ITMGCを認めたすべての生検でPLAPの免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色は陽性であった。胚細胞腫瘍を認めない対照の471例の生検では、精原細胞にPLAPは認められなかった。胚細胞腫瘍を疑われた不妊症の生検で偶発的にセミノーマを認めた2例も考察した。これらの結果から、ITMGCは浸潤性病変へ進行する率が高いが、経過が緩徐な場合もあることが示された。PLAPはITMGCの鋭敏かつ特異的なマーカーであり、診断を容易にする。
